_readme: Copy to queue.json (git-ignored) and run scripts/lego_council_workflow.py with Args {"queue_file": "<workspace>/queue.json", "concurrency": 3, "max_rounds": 10, "item_rounds": 3, "priority_note": "..."}. Items run top to bottom; edit the file any time. Use 'brief_file' for an existing fact sheet (docs/facts/<slug>.md) or 'topic' to have the researcher write one. When nothing is pending, a topic scout adds 6 new researched topics.

items.topic: Mirroring (tactic explainer, Never Split the Difference): repeat the last 1-3 words as a question. Source: Chris Voss & Tahl Raz (2016); documented case or a clearly dramatized example.
Story, sports contract (1976): the Spirits of St. Louis owners' 'forever' share of NBA TV money.
